import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\kowli\Downloads\heart_disease_health_indicators_BRFSS2015.csv")

print("First 5 Rows")
print(df.head())
print("\nLast 5 Rows")
print(df.tail())
print("\nShape of Dataset")
print(df.shape)
print("\nDataset Information")
print(df.info())
print("\nStatistical Summary")
print(df.describe())

print("\nMissing Values")
print(df.isnull().sum())
print("\nDuplicate Rows")
print(df.duplicated().sum())

df = df.drop_duplicates()

print("\nShape After Removing Duplicates")
print(df.shape)

print("\nData Types")
print(df.dtypes)

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Heart Disease Distribution")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.histplot(df["BMI"], bins=30, kde=True)
plt.title("BMI Distribution")
plt.show()


plt.figure(figsize=(14,10))
sns.heatmap(df.corr(), annot=False, cmap="coolwarm")
plt.title("Correlation Heatmap")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="HighBP", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("High Blood Pressure vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="HighChol", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("High Cholesterol vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="Diabetes", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Diabetes vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="Smoker", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Smoking vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="PhysActivity", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Physical Activity vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="Fruits", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Fruit Consumption vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="Veggies", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Vegetable Consumption vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.countplot(x="Sex", hue="HeartDiseaseorAttack", data=df)
plt.title("Gender vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.countplot(x="Age", data=df)
plt.title("Age Distribution")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.countplot(x="GenHlth", data=df)
plt.title("General Health")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.boxplot(x="HeartDiseaseorAttack", y="BMI", data=df)
plt.title("BMI vs Heart Disease")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.histplot(df["MentHlth"], bins=30, kde=True)
plt.title("Mental Health Days")
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.histplot(df["PhysHlth"], bins=30, kde=True)
plt.title("Physical Health Days")
plt.show()

sns.pairplot(df[["BMI","MentHlth","PhysHlth","HeartDiseaseorAttack"]])
plt.show()

print("\nCorrelation with Heart Disease")
print(df.corr()["HeartDiseaseorAttack"].sort_values(ascending=False))

print("\nEDA Completed Successfully!")
